modelId.description: Base model the document is built on (the `modelId` supplied at create). Immutable — echoed here so a GET round-trips through PATCH; supplying a different value on PATCH is rejected.

workbookModelId.description: Server-assigned WORKBOOK-layer model layered on `modelId`. Read-only — echoed here so a GET round-trips through PATCH; each draft has its own, so a draft read returns the draft workbook’s model.

url.description: API path of the app sub-resource, where the app's HTML and settings are read and written. The sub-resource is an alpha surface: its shapes may change without a deprecation cycle while apps mature. The document routes are stable.

DocumentsV2AppSlice.description: Present only for app documents, and only while apps are enabled for the organization. The app's HTML and settings live at the `url` sub-resource (`PUT` / `PATCH …/draft/app` or `…/draft/{draftIdentifier}/app`); the document body carries nothing app-scoped.

StackContainer.description: Stack container — an ordered list of nested children (content, grid, stack, or reference).

ReferenceContainer.description: Reference container — points at another container in the collection by its instanceKey.

description.description: Optional description for the container, providing additional context or information

instanceKey.description: Unique identifier for this container. Used to reference the container when adding, moving, or removing children.

name.description: Human-readable name for the container, used for easier reference in logic and design

PageContainer.description: Page container — a top-level page wrapping a single grid, stack, or reference container, optionally per breakpoint/media.

config.description: Filter or interactive control config. Discriminated by `type`: filter types (string, date, number, etc.) or control types (FIELD_SELECTION, PERIOD_OVER_PERIOD, etc.). Visibility is determined by placement in the filter-bar container.

map.description: Per-tile field overrides keyed by tab ID. Values are a field name (override) or false (exclude tile from control).

filters.description: Child filters — each a simple filter or another composite filter. Recursive; see the dashboard-filters reference for the full grammar.

JsonValue.description: Arbitrary JSON value (string, number, boolean, null, object, or array).

data.description: Query presentations keyed by tab ID. A FOREIGN tab — one whose query runs against a shared model other than this document’s — carries its execution model at `foreignModelId`.

automaticVis.description: When true, the system automatically selects the best visualization type.

editingModelObjectName.description: Model object (view/topic) currently being edited via the dataset/query-view editor. Applies only to dataset / query-view tabs — omitted from reads and rejected on patches for other tab types.

editingModelObjectNameChange.description: Pending rename of the model object being edited. Applies only to dataset / query-view tabs — omitted from reads and rejected on patches for other tab types.

fileUploadId.description: File upload backing this tab (a CSV data-input / Source tab or a spreadsheet tab). Applies only to csv / spreadsheet tabs — rejected on patches for other tab types.

filterOrder.description: Ordered list of filter field names controlling display order on this tab.

isSql.description: Whether this tab is in raw SQL mode.

prefersChart.description: When true, the chart view is shown by default instead of the data table.

aiGenerated.description: True when AI generated this query’s SQL; the AI SQL is shown in the advanced SQL box.

branch_id.description: Branch model ID when querying against a model branch.

allow_refs_to_unselected_fields.description: Set by the Kotlin parser when this calc references fields not selected at the top level (AI SQL-gen produces these; UI-authored calcs do not).

anchor_row.description: The 1-indexed row the Excel-style formula was authored against, so row-relative references resolve to the intended offsets — e.g. a percent-of-previous "=B4/B5" authored on row 5. Only used when sql_expression is omitted; defaults to 1 (B1 = this row).

calc_name.description: Internal identifier for the calculation, used as the column alias.

label.description: Display label shown in the UI.

original_formula.description: The calculation formula. Prefer referencing selected fields by name (e.g. "=SUM(orders.revenue)") — name references are stable under column reordering and have no row semantics. Excel-style references also work: column letters map to the query's fields in table order (A = the first field) with rows anchored at row 1 (set anchor_row to author row-relative references against a different row), and calc columns can only be referenced by letter. When sql_expression is omitted, the server parses this formula on write and rejects the request if it does not parse.

outside_pivot.description: When true, the calculation is evaluated outside the pivot grouping.

pushdown.description: Per-calc override for whether to evaluate before the row limit. `null` defers to the model-level default.

sql.description: Compiled SQL string produced from the formula.

sql_expression.description: Parsed SQL expression tree (serialized, server-internal format). Omit it to have the server parse original_formula instead.

swallow_errors.description: When true, calculation errors are silently swallowed instead of surfaced.

calculations.description: Table calculations attached to this query.

column_limit.description: Max number of pivot columns to return.

column_totals.description: Column-level aggregation totals, keyed by field name.

controls.description: Interactive controls (field selectors, PoP controls) attached to this query.

cube_metadata.description: Cube-specific metadata (topic name, cube name, hash key) for cube-backed queries.

custom_summary_types.description: Per-field custom summary functions (e.g. SUM, AVG, COUNT).

dbtFileName.description: dbt file name when this query is backed by a dbt model.

dbtMode.description: Whether this query is in dbt mode.

default_group_by.description: When true, all dimensions are implicitly included in GROUP BY, unless the model's default_group_by setting (never or primary_key) suppresses it.

dimensionIndex.description: Index of the primary dimension used for result ordering.

executableSQL.description: Server-compiled SQL string (read-only, set by the backend).

fields.description: Model field names selected for the query (dimensions + measures).

fill_fields.description: Fields whose missing date/time values should be filled with nulls to create continuous series.

filters.description: Query filters keyed by filter ID.

filtersUsedInSql.description: Filters that were embedded directly in raw SQL (read-only).

imported_model_ids.description: Model IDs (UUIDs) the query reaches through its composite topic's imports — the topic's import_models entries, which must be model ids, not names. Authorization requires the run gate on each; omit only for queries that do not touch imported topics.

join_paths_from_topic_name.description: Topic name that determines join path precedence for parsed SQL queries.

join_via_map.description: Virtual topic join path overrides, keyed by view name to ordered join path.

manualSort.description: When true, the user has explicitly set a custom sort order.

model_extension_id.description: The query model this query is bound to — a model extension layered on this document’s workbook model. Exposed on read. Server-owned on write: a value supplied on PATCH or create is ignored and the tile keeps its existing binding, so editing a tile cannot orphan its query model. An entry that carries no `query` clears the tile’s query, dropping the binding with it. Changing a binding is a draft-scoped operation, not expressible through this field. The id is a draft-local clone and is not stable across the publish cycle — each draft re-clones its query models under a new workbook model. LINKED tabs don’t carry one: their query, and its binding, come from the source tab.

parsed.description: Whether this raw SQL query has been parsed into a semantic query.

periodOverPeriodTransposed.description: Whether the period-over-period comparison columns are transposed.

date_filter_field_name.description: The date dimension field this comparison is anchored to.

date_filter_id.description: ID of the date filter being offset (if backed by a dashboard filter).

is_dynamic_previous_period.description: When true, the previous period is calculated dynamically relative to the current filter range.

periods_ago.description: How many periods back to compare (e.g. 1 = previous period). Null if not set.

time_unit_name.description: Time grain for the offset (e.g. "month", "year"). Null if not set.

pivots.description: Field names to pivot on (columns become values).

rewriteSql.description: When true, the backend should rewrite/optimize the SQL.

row_totals.description: Row-level aggregation totals, keyed by field name.

column_name.description: The model field name to sort by.

is_column_sort.description: When true, this sort targets a pivoted column rather than a row dimension.

pivot_value_map.description: Maps pivot field names to specific pivot values, scoping the sort to a single pivot column.

sort_descending.description: When true, sort order is descending.

subtotal_sort.description: Field name whose subtotal row should be used as the sort key.

sorts.description: Sort clauses applied to the query result set.

sqlSortsEnabled.description: Whether user-created sorts are enabled on a raw SQL query.

staticQueryReferences.description: Pre-computed query references for AI chat context. Inner shape is `OmniQuery & { model_id: string }`; left as `unknown` to avoid a recursive zod schema. Validated structurally by consumers when they execute the referenced sub-queries.

table.description: Base view (table) name in the model.

transposed_measures.description: Measure field names that have been transposed into rows.

userEditedSQL.description: User-authored raw SQL (empty string when not in SQL mode).

query.description: The semantic query for this tab, minus the server-owned `modelId` anchor (the workbook id, echoed at the document root; a FOREIGN tab’s execution model surfaces as the tile-level `foreignModelId` instead). Its `model_extension_id` — the query-model binding — is exposed here but is server-owned on write (see the field’s own description). For LINKED-type tabs this field is read-only.

resultConfig.description: Result display configuration (column widths, frozen columns, conditional formatting, number formatting, etc.).

topicName.description: The topic (explore) this query is built on.

type.description: The query presentation type (e.g. SEMANTIC, SQL, LINKED, SPREADSHEET). `foreign` is only valid when echoing an existing foreign tab at the same key — a tab cannot be created as, or converted to/from, FOREIGN through this API.

fields.description: Field names used in the visualization axes/series.

version.description: Schema version for vis config migration.

config.description: The vis-type-specific spec — KPI rows, chart mark/series, etc. GET nests the spec here; PATCH also accepts it spread flat next to visType for backward compatibility.

visConfig.description: Inner visualization config — structure varies by visType.

foreignModelId.description: Present only on FOREIGN tabs: the shared model this tab’s query executes against (a different model than the document’s). Stable across publishes. Server-owned on write — a supplied value is ignored and the tab keeps its stored execution model. Omitted for every other tab type.

sourceQueryPresentationKey.description: For LINKED-type tabs, the record key — the same identifier used as a `queryPresentations.data` key — of the source tile whose query this tab reuses. Null for all other tab types. This is a tile record key, NOT a positional index into `order`.

crossfilterEnabled.description: When true, clicking a value in one tile filters all other tiles on the dashboard.

queryError.description: Custom text shown when a query errors, replacing the default error text.

queryNoResults.description: Custom text shown when a query returns no results, replacing the default empty state.

customText.description: Custom text replacing default UI strings on the dashboard, e.g. when queries error or return no results.

facetFilters.description: When true, dashboard filters are applied per-facet when faceting is active.

refreshInterval.description: Auto-refresh interval in seconds. Null disables auto-refresh.

runQueriesOn.description: Controls whether dashboard queries execute on the visible page or across all pages.

identifier.description: Identifier of the newly created document.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings — present only when there are any. Currently: external resource hosts the app's iframe CSP will block until an org admin allows them (`app` creates only). The document was still created and published. Advisory prose, not a contract: the wording is deliberately volatile, there are no per-warning codes, and consumers must not branch on the content. The render-time CSP is the enforcement.

draftIdentifier.description: Identifier of the draft the patch was applied to.

identifier.description: Published document identifier the draft targets.

draftOutOfDate.description: True when the published document was published more recently than the draft was created (the draft is based on a stale baseline)

identifier.description: Draft workbook identifier — use this to address the draft

allOf.description: User who most recently edited the draft

publishedIdentifier.description: Identifier of the published document the draft is for

updatedAt.description: Most recent edit time on the draft workbook

workbookModelId.description: omni_model ID for the draft workbook

ApiDraftBranch.description: Branch the draft is attached to, or null for a draft on main

ApiDraftStatus.description: Lifecycle status: "active" for current drafts, "archived" for soft-deleted drafts (retained ~7 days)

permits.description: User permits for the document. Present only when userId is provided.

requirePullRequestToPublish.description: Require pull request to publish changes

DocumentAbilities.description: Document-level ability values, as stored on the document

description.description: For a user permit, the user's email address, or an SSO embed user's embed email. For an organization-wide permit, "Organization" or "Organization - via Folder". Absent for user groups.

isOwner.description: Derived; an OWNER role also implies ownership

PermitLayer.description: Access granted directly on the document

FolderInfo.description: The folder the inherited access came from

baseModelId.description: Base model ID for branch/extension models

nextCursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page

totalRecords.description: Total number of records matching the query

topics.description: List of topics, regular and composite

base_view_name.description: Base view name for the topic

is_composite.description: Absent (or false) on a regular topic

hidden.description: Whether the composite topic is hidden

import_models.description: Models this composite topic imports topics from

is_composite.description: Marks a composite topic, which combines other topics

model_ref.description: Id of the model the topics are imported from

alias.description: Local alias for the imported topic

ignored.description: Whether the imported topic is ignored

topic.description: Name of the topic in the source model

topics.description: Topics imported from the source model

topic.description: Topic details with relationships and views

base_view_name.description: Base view name for the topic

is_composite.description: Absent (or false) on a regular topic

always_join_all_topics.description: When true, queries join every component topic instead of pruning unused ones

cache_policy.description: Named cache policy; unset resolves to the strictest component topic policy

default_filters.description: Filters applied to every query on the topic

hidden.description: Whether the composite topic is hidden

import_models.description: Models this composite topic imports topics from

is_composite.description: Marks a composite topic, which combines other topics

sample_queries.description: Modeler-curated example queries for the topic

shared_dimensions.description: Dimensions coalesced across the component topics

shared_views.description: Views shared across the component topics

views.description: Views available in the composite topic

documents.description: Number of documents in the folder

favorites.description: Number of users who have favorited this folder

ownerId.description: User ID of the folder owner

url.description: URL to view the folder in the Omni UI.

accessBoost.description: Whether access boost is enabled for this permit

role.description: Content role (e.g., VIEWER, EDITOR, MANAGER, OWNER)

userGroupId.description: User group ID if this is a group permit

userId.description: User ID if this is a user permit

permits.description: List of permission permits for the folder

favorites.description: Number of users who favorited this document

_count.description: Document counts (included when _count is in include param)

connectionId.description: Connection ID the document is associated with

hasApp.description: Whether the document has an associated app

hasDashboard.description: Whether the document has an associated dashboard

labels.description: Labels applied to the document (included when labels is in include param)

url.description: URL to view the document. Returns the dashboard URL if it has a dashboard, the app URL if it has an app, otherwise the workbook URL.

keyScope.description: Scope of the API key in use. A separate axis from role: a user-scoped key (PAT/OAuth) acts as a single user and cannot use SCIM, regardless of the user's org role.

rolesByModel.description: Resolved role and effective permissions per model, keyed by model id. Connection role resolves per shared model, so this is per-model rather than a single global role.

rolesByModelTruncated.description: Present and `true` when `rolesByModel` was truncated because the caller can access more models than the unfiltered limit. Pass a `modelId` filter to retrieve specific models.

baseRole.description: The resolved base role (for custom roles, the base role they extend).

connectionId.description: The connection this model belongs to

permissions.description: The caller's resolved/effective permissions on this model, reflecting custom roles. This is a capability signal for the directly-roleable model kinds (schema / shared / extension). It does not enumerate the permissions you derive on branch, workbook, and query models from your role on the base model they descend from — absence here does not mean you lack access on those derived models. MANAGE_MODEL, READ, and REFRESH_SCHEMA are also not reported: they derive from connection / sibling-model roles rather than a per-model rule.

roleName.description: The resolved role name (informational; may be a custom role). Use `permissions` to decide capability.

membershipId.description: The caller's own membership id within this organization. This is the id accepted by the admin `GET /api/v1/users/{id}/model-roles` endpoint (it is distinct from the user id).

cache_metadata.description: Cache metadata for the result (row count, byte size, freshness timestamps, requery plan key).

client_result_id.description: Client-supplied result ID echoed back for correlating jobs to queries.

error.description: Structured error details, e.g. an OAuth re-authentication requirement.

error_message.description: Human-readable error message. Present on failed jobs.

error_type.description: Machine-readable error category (e.g. PLAN, SQL). Present on failed jobs.

job_id.description: ID of the query job this line reports on.

kill_reason.description: Why the job was killed, when it was cancelled.

requery_sql.description: SQL to re-query the cached result set, when the result supports requery.

result.description: Result rows as a base64-encoded Arrow IPC stream. Present on completed jobs. Decode with any Arrow IPC reader and use summary.fields to interpret the columns.

status.description: Job status. Known values include COMPLETE, ERROR, FAILED, and MISSING; new values may be added over time.

stream_stats.description: Server-side streaming latency stats, in milliseconds.

summary.description: Execution summary. summary.fields maps field names to their metadata and is needed to interpret the decoded Arrow table; also carries the generated SQL and cache type.

QueryStreamJobLine.description: Per-job line emitted as each job reaches a terminal state. A completed job carries the result set as base64-encoded Arrow IPC in `result`; a failed job carries `error_type` and `error_message` instead.

remaining_job_ids.description: Job IDs that had not completed when the wait window elapsed. Poll /api/v1/query/wait with these IDs until the list is empty.

timed_out.description: Whether the wait window elapsed before every job completed. Note: a string ("true"/"false"), not a boolean.

jobs_submitted.description: Map of submitted job ID to the client result ID for that job (null when the job has no client result ID). Job IDs are the keys to poll via /api/v1/query/wait.

QueryStreamJobsSubmittedLine.description: First line of the query/run stream: the jobs accepted for execution.
